description: This file defines the interface for the Device Service Gatherer component, which collects various device-related statistics and statuses in a Zigbee-enabled system. It contains function declarations for gathering device, network, firmware, camera, and status information, mainly via a 'runtimeStatsPojo' data structure.

methods.name: collectAllDeviceStatistics
methods.description: Collects all information about each device on the system, adding it to runtimeStatsPojo output, including rejoin info, check-in info, attribute reports, endpoints, resources, and counters.

methods.name: collectZigbeeNetworkCounters
methods.description: Gathers Zigbee network counters and adds them to runtimeStatsPojo.

methods.name: collectZigbeeCoreNetworkStatistics
methods.description: Collects Zigbee core network status details such as panID, channel, network status, and EUI-64.

methods.name: collectAllDeviceFirmwareEvents
methods.description: Gathers firmware failure events related to Zigbee devices.

methods.name: collectCameraDeviceStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics about camera devices and adds to runtimeStatsPojo.

methods.name: collectAllDeviceStatus
methods.description: Collects device service status information into a serviceStatusPojo.
